Definition: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to divide, separate; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to divide, separate, sever; 1a2) to separate, set apart; 1a3) to make a distinction, difference; 1a4) to divide into parts; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to separate oneself from (reflexive of 1a2); 1b2) to withdraw from; 1b3) to separate oneself unto; 1b4) to be separated; 1b5) to be excluded; 1b6) to be set apart
